_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for NZIHL/NZWIHL player-name corrections used across every broadcast-asset repo (roster PDFs, player photo warehouse, live overlays). Edit ONLY this file -- consumers fetch it at runtime/scrape-time and fall back to a small hardcoded snapshot if the fetch fails, so a network hiccup never breaks an on-air graphic. See matchavez/hockey's nzihl_player_name_overrides memory for the full history of why each entry exists.

team_jersey_overrides.note: Canterbury Inferno -- esportsdesk stores her as 'Shattock (Niskakoski)', a maiden-name parenthetical baked into the source title attribute.

Pure NZ Admirals -- belt-and-suspenders exact override on top of the multi_word_surnames allowlist entry above (which already keeps 'De Jonge' whole on its own). first=null means don't touch the first name.

parenthetical_strips.note: Strip Reagyn Shattock's maiden-name parenthetical from any raw scraped text before parsing (goal/assist/penalty rows, title attributes, etc.).

Player goes by LJ -- esportsdesk stores her as 'Lucy-Jane(LJ) Hart', a nickname parenthetical embedded IN the name (not a trailing maiden-name case like Shattock). Left unstripped, the embedded '(' was mistaken for the assist-list open-paren by the goal/assist row regex, garbling the assist field (flagged 2026-07-18, unfixed until now). Strip cleans the raw name to 'Lucy-Jane Hart' before parsing; surname_text_overrides then forces the short display to 'LJ Hart'.

Player goes by Lucy -- esportsdesk stores her as 'Lucia (Lucy) Eccleton-Allen', same embedded-nickname-parenthetical pattern as LJ Hart above. Strip cleans the raw name to 'Lucia Eccleton-Allen' before parsing; surname_text_overrides then forces the short display to 'Lucy Eccleton-Allen'.
